faults.title: Download failed or offline
faults.body: Open Models & resources to review errors and retry. Verified models work offline; active downloads can be cancelled.

faults.title: Image or preview failed
faults.body: Choose Retry in the canvas. If it still fails, check that the file is intact and its format is supported, or import it again.

faults.title: Batch jobs stopped
faults.body: Check whether the batch is paused. Filter Failed & cancelled to review and retry. Reviewing an original keeps the batch and exports.

faults.title: Cannot save a result
faults.body: Choose a writable local destination and check free disk space. Existing originals and results are kept.

extra.updatesBody: This development build does not include automatic updates. Distribution and signing validation are tracked in the project docs.
extra.keyboardSelection: Selection supports the keyboard: focus the canvas, move with arrow keys, and press Enter to add a point. Hold Shift to move faster.
extra.inputFormats: Inputs: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF, ICO, TGA, DDS, PNM, QOI and Farbfeld. GIF uses the first frame, TIFF the first page and ICO the preferred icon. 16-bit integer channels are converted to 8-bit sRGB. Animated PNG/WebP, HEIC, AVIF, RAW, HDR and SVG are not supported. Results are PNG.

copy.title: Help & about
copy.intro: From import to export, image processing stays on this device.

steps.title: Import images
steps.body: Choose an image in the workspace, drop one into the window, or paste one from the clipboard.

steps.title: Choose a cutout method
steps.body: Automatic uses IS-Net. Selection lets you add subject and background points. The desktop app prepares the models at startup.

steps.title: Review and touch up
steps.body: Switch between original and result. After processing, refine edges, keep or erase areas with the brush, and choose a transparent, solid, or local image background.

steps.title: Save results
steps.body: Export a single PNG, or use Batch jobs to save PNGs and start a ZIP export while processing continues.

copy.privacyBody: Originals, masks and exports stay on this device. The desktop app downloads missing models at startup.
copy.licensesBody: See each model’s size, license and download state in Models & resources.
